title: Item:Bottle of Freezing Mist
wikitext:
{{Nonconsumable | name = Bottle of Freezing Mist | picdesc = Bottle of Freezing Mist.png | acquired = [[Olkresh]] | location = [[House Jorasco]], [[Eveningstar]], and Eberron [[Hall of Heroes]] | minlevel = 1 | bind = {{Bind|BtA|BoA}} | effect = Clicky: {{Clicky|Expanded Teleport|7|no|N/A}} | cost = 300 pp | weight = 0.01 lbs | stack = 1 | description = Freezing Mist swirls within this tiny bottle, filling you with dread.

This item is capable of Teleporting you to a variety of locations depending on what you've unlocked.

This item has a one-minute cooldown as the mists gather back into the bottle. | notes = ** Ownership of this item unlocks the [[Ludendorf City Hall]] destination for Expanded Teleport. *** If you have not yet completed the quest [[The Body Snatchers]] this life, this item will not send you to the advertised destination. It will instead place you in [[House Jorasco]], near the entrance to that quest. ** As of [[Update 80]], the cooldown is 20 seconds, but {{bug|this is not reflected in the description|term=}}. }}
